research_notes: The present sample is write-heavy enough that its eventual close overhead may include repository variability not seen in reasoning-heavy work.
That is acceptable for W3, but cross-profile validation should avoid assuming this overhead distribution is universal.
The hard cap may ultimately use a conservative reserve derived from the slowest representative profile.
Alternatively profile-conditioned reserve can be considered only if the complexity buys material utilization.
The same simplicity criterion applies to reserve selection as to task admission.
Current Phase A records evidence without deciding that policy yet.
